tagline: A baby rain cloud, her hedgehog best friend, and a meadow full of surprises.
audience: MADE FOR KIDS (ages 2-7). Channel and every video must be set to made for kids.
format: Wordless slapstick-and-heart cartoon, 30-45s. Drizzle's surprise rain (bubbles, petals, snowflakes, colours...) causes a small problem, friends solve it together kindly, and every episode ends with the signature Puddle Jump celebration. No spoken words, only cute sounds, so it works in every country.
style_prompt: high-quality soft 3D animated preschool film style, rounded chubby shapes, huge sparkling eyes, gentle expressive faces, bright but soft pastel palette of sky blue, mint green, butter yellow and lilac, warm sunny lighting, cosy storybook meadow world, vertical 9:16 composition with the characters centred, no text, no logos
audio_prompt: no spoken words; only cute non-verbal character sounds (giggles, gasps, hiccups, 'ooh', 'uh-oh', 'yay'), soft cartoon sound effects, gentle nature ambience, no background music (music is added in post)
negative_prompt: scary, dark, violent, sharp teeth, realistic animals, humans, text, logos, brand products, danger, crying for long, mean faces
kids_safety_rules: Nothing a child could copy that is unsafe: no climbing high, no fire, no going into deep water, no eating things found outside, no running near roads, no tricks with heights.
Every problem is solved kindly within the episode; nobody is left sad, excluded or scared at the end.
Gentle pacing: no flashing, no jump scares, no screaming.
No products, brands, food promotion or toys being sold.
Each episode quietly models one good thing: sharing, helping, trying again, saying sorry, curiosity, counting, colours or shapes.
signature: Every episode ends with the Puddle Jump: Drizzle drips a perfect round puddle, Pudge jumps in with both feet, a happy splash in slow motion, both giggle and wave.
